{"id":1809410993,"question_id":3768,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"9 months","timestamp":1761222674,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"8 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1809410993/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Check If Digits Are Equal in String After Operations I","memory":"10.6 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    bool hasSameDigits(string s) {\n        queue<char>q;\n\n        for(auto ch : s) q.push(ch);\n\n        while(q.size() != 2)\n        {\n            int repeat = q.size()-1;\n            while(repeat--)\n            {\n                int front = q.front()-'0';\n                q.pop();\n                int next_front = q.front()-'0';\n\n                int sum = (front + next_front) % 10;\n                q.push(sum + '0');\n            }\n            if(!q.empty()) q.pop();\n        }\n\n        string ans =\"\";\n        while(!q.empty())\n        {\n            ans.push_back(q.front());\n            q.pop();\n        }\n\n        return ans[0] == ans[1];\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"check-if-digits-are-equal-in-string-after-operations-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":950}
